heading: Software engineer. Curious how far down it goes.
paragraphs: Five years building production software for Disney and Aeroméxico: microfrontend platforms, Backend for Frontend services, microservices integration, API design. Every layer I worked on sat on top of another one I hadn't opened yet. So now I'm opening them: Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, how processes share memory, what a database does between the query and the disk. The problems without clean answers, the ones I came into this industry to solve.

I'm drawn to teams where craft and hard problems coexist. Good abstractions, low latency, contracts that hold: the things that make or break software quietly. I want to know where each one breaks, and build things that stay fast and don't become someone else's problem six months later.
Outside of work I'm building Medixio, an AI agent for chronic care, and relearning math from the ground up.
